context: Merged lane/02-exchange into foundation/v3 (no conflicts); wired twining_exchange_status onto the MCP surface, which the lane had left registry-only, and re-pinned the command counts 39→40 / default 15→16.
rationale: the command declares surface:'default' in its own definition, the CLI already reaches it through commandRegistry, and leaving it MCP-invisible would mean an agent could not ask 'what is this replica uncertain about?' without an operator widening the surface, which is exactly what R20 forbids. Alternative rejected: mark it surface:'full' to dodge the default-surface count change — that contradicts the lane's recorded rationale.
summary: Chose to add src/tools/exchange-tools.ts and register twining_exchange_status on the DEFAULT MCP surface rather than relaxing the registry↔MCP parity test
